description.zh: 用户组属性的值。长度为1~128个字符。
description.en: The value of a user group property. The value must be 1 to 128 characters in length.

description.zh: 分页查询时显示的当前页的页码。取值：1~10000。
description.en: The page number of the current page in a paged query. Valid values: 1 to 10000.

description.zh: 用户组名称。长度为1~128个字符，支持中文和大小写英文字母，可包含数字、半角句号（.）、下划线（_）和短划线（-）。
description.en: The name of the user group. The name must be 1 to 128 characters in length. It can contain letters, digits, periods (.), underscores (\_), and hyphens (-). It supports both uppercase and lowercase letters and Chinese characters.

description.zh:
内网访问策略ID。取值来源：
- [ListPrivateAccessPolices](~~ListPrivateAccessPolices~~)：批量查询内网访问策略。
- [CreatePrivateAccessPolicy](~~CreatePrivateAccessPolicy~~)：创建内网访问策略。
description.en:
The ID of an internal network access policy. You can get this value from:

- [ListPrivateAccessPolices](~~ListPrivateAccessPolices~~): List internal network access policies.

- [CreatePrivateAccessPolicy](~~CreatePrivateAccessPolicy~~): Create an internal network access policy.

description.zh: 分页查询时设置的每页数量。取值：1~1000。
description.en: The number of entries per page in a paged query. Valid values: 1 to 1000.

description.zh: 用户组ID集合。最多可输入100个用户组ID。
description.en: A collection of user group IDs. You can specify up to 100 IDs.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun csas list-user-groups --current-page 1 --page-size 10 --user-group-ids usergroup-6f1ef2fc56b60000 --name user_group_name --attribute-value username --pa-policy-id pa-policy-54a7838a48bf0000 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun csas ListUserGroups --region cn-hangzhou --AttributeValue username --PageSize 10 --UserGroupIds.1 'usergroup-6f1ef2fc56b60000' --CurrentPage 1 --PAPolicyId 'pa-policy-54a7838a48bf0000' --Name user_group_name --force
